```yaml
name: Publish Bulk CDK Extract

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: 'Dry run (do not publish to Maven Central)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish-extract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: gradle

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v3

      - name: Build Extract CDK
        run: ./gradlew :airbyte-cdk:bulk:core:extract:build

      - name: Publish Extract CDK
        env:
          ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_sonatypeUsername: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}
          ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_sonatypePassword: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}
          ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_signingKey: ${{ secrets.SIGNING_KEY }}
          ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_signingPassword: ${{ secrets.SIGNING_PASSWORD }}
          ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_dryRun: ${{ inputs.dry_run }}
        run: ./gradlew :airbyte-cdk:bulk:core:extract:publish
```
